title: Joint Gaussian threshold probability
statement: Let $\rho,s,t\in\mathbb R$ and suppose $\sqrt{1-\rho^2}>0$. For independent standard Gaussian variables $X,Y$, the probability that $X\le s$ and $\rho X+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,Y\le t$ equals $\displaystyle\int_{(-\infty,s]}\Phi\!\left(\frac{t-\rho x}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}\right)\,d\gamma(x)$, where $\gamma$ is standard Gaussian measure and $\Phi$ its distribution function.
